scope: Incidental SIGABRT during one Fuel Goes Here fixture launch; isolated evidence only
status: intermittent; one startup SIGABRT, not reproduced by subsequent starts of the same fixture configuration
scenario: In-frame client startup with test terrain, one content-only Fuel Goes Here hmod containing data/fuelgoeshere/tags/item/forced_fuels.json, fresh temporary HORIZON_HOME/launcher/XDG homes, taskset CPU 0-5, nice 10, RAYON_NUM_THREADS=6.

event.phase: startup while content_root builds merged content, before resources and gameplay loaded

all_threads.main: allocator detected invalid pointer while dropping nested Vec<String> values in horizon_client::mod_content::build -> resource_root -> content_root
all_threads.other_threads: one logging worker parked receiving log messages; no gameplay, machine, worker pool, or teardown had started

causality_limit: These frames and the deallocation location show where the allocator detected corruption, not which operation introduced it. Four later starts of the same fixture configuration (on rebuilt binaries) completed startup; the gameplay assertions reached the tag lookup. This is not a consistent reproduction and does not localize the earlier teardown corruption.
gdb: coredumpctl info and gdb thread apply all bt 30; two threads in the preserved core. Extracted inspection copy: /tmp/horizon-core-316712.
impact: The test fixture used temporary homes. No repository data was deleted or reset.
